- Added `REPORT.md` documenting per-block semantics.

**Real commands run and results:** all 12 acceptance commands (`python3 -m pytest -q` per unit; `python3 -m pytest -q tests/` for chain; `python3 check.py` for alpha/beta) exited 0 — csvfix 2, rules 1, ledger 2, schedule 2, intervals 7, flags 8, measure 1, slugify 1, ranges 1, chain 4 passed; alpha/beta `ok`.
